sections.heading: What is Narrowing unknown at API and JSON boundaries?

blocks.text: **Narrowing unknown at API and JSON boundaries** is a compile-time TypeScript concept that erases at emit — the run-time behavior is still JavaScript. Narrowing unknown at API and JSON boundaries lets TypeScript narrow unions after runtime checks — typeof, in, instanceof, user-defined predicates, and assert functions.
